title: Switch record height UI and validation from centimeters to inches

requirements.summary: Update height field UI text to use inches in the create/edit form and record detail view.
acceptanceCriteria: In the record form, the height label reads "Height (in)" (or "Height (inches)") instead of "Height (cm)".
In the record detail view, the height value is displayed with an inches suffix (e.g., "70 in") instead of centimeters.
No other field labels/units are changed.

file_operations.description: Change the height input label from centimeters to inches (e.g., update "Height (cm)" to "Height (in)"). Keep all other field labels/units unchanged.
Update the height display suffix from "cm" to "in" in the record detail view. Do not change any other displayed units (e.g., weight stays "kg").

requirements.summary: Update frontend height validation to validate inches (range + error message), while keeping height optional and non-numeric messaging unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a height value outside the new inches range shows a height validation error that references inches (not centimeters).
Submitting a non-numeric height continues to show "Height must be a number".
Height remains optional (empty height is allowed).

file_operations.description: Update height validation to treat the input as inches (not centimeters): adjust the allowed numeric range to an inches-appropriate range (e.g., 31–98) and update the range validation error message to reference inches ("in"/"inches"). Keep the non-numeric message exactly "Height must be a number" and keep height optional.
